name: bastra-recall-monorepo
description: Workspace root for bastra-recall: OSS daemon, MCP server, and shared ChatGPT/Codex/Claude skill — the open foundation under the Bastra Mac app.

scripts.build:deploy: npm run build && npm run build:stub --workspace=@bastra-recall/daemon && node packages/daemon/scripts/verify-stub-build.mjs
scripts.pretest: npm run build --workspace=@bastra-recall/core && npm run build --workspace=@bastra-recall/daemon
scripts.test: node --import tsx --import ./scripts/test-env.mjs --test --test-concurrency=2 packages/core/__tests__/*.test.ts packages/daemon/__tests__/*.test.ts packages/eval/__tests__/*.test.ts tools/__tests__/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:changed: echo 'Missing/stale map or NOT VOUCHED? Run npm test for the full suite, or npm run test:map on a clean tree to rebuild the map.' && node tools/test-map.mjs select --run
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@bastra-recall/core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@bastra-recall/statusline && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@bastra-recall/daemon && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=bastra-recall
scripts.lint: npm run lint:baselines && npm run lint:structure && npm run lint:cycles && npm run lint:clones
scripts.lint:prune: npm run lint:structure:prune && npm run lint:cycles:prune && npm run lint:clones:prune
